Author: Nainaiowo
Name: Better Deaths
Description: Records party deaths with pull grouping, fatal events, active statuses, and recent action timelines.
Changelog:
Food Check
- Added a height slider for party plate tints, from 20% to 100% of the row. The tint stays vertically centered, and the preview reflects its height.

Food Check
- Moved food status controls into their own Food Check section, separate from Party Cooldowns.
- Choose a warning threshold, show warnings only, or optionally tint party plates by food status. Tint strength is adjustable from 4% to 40% and starts disabled.
- The preview distinguishes healthy, expiring, missing, and unavailable status so unavailable data is not mistaken for missing food.
- Live status still updates once per second only while out of combat inside an instance; /foodcheck remains available for a system-chat report.

Party cooldowns
- Default now asks before restoring the selected side's layout and every job's default ability list and one-row layout.
- The other side's placement and live cooldown timers are preserved.

Death information
- Enemy damage-downs active at death now appear in summaries even when they are missing from the captured killing-hit snapshot.
- Enemy mitigation icons keep their border and identify the source on hover when available.
